blocks.text: Reimagining histories and alternative futures through the transformative power of the photographic image.

Established in 1994 in Mali’s capital, Bamako Encounters has played a formative role in developing and internationally recognising contemporary African photography. For more than three decades, the biennial has given artists from Africa and its global diaspora a platform to challenge established visual narratives, reclaim histories, and articulate their own perspectives on a changing world.

Under the curatorial direction of Armelle Dakouo, the 15th edition, Refabulation(s) , brings together 49 artists to explore the narrative power of images and their capacity to reconfigure our understanding of reality. Extending beyond conventional photographic practices, the biennial embraces moving images, installation, sound and sculpture, examining the intersections of memory, fiction, history and collective imagination.

Through exhibitions, public programmes and professional exchanges, Refabulation(s) considers photography not simply as a means of documenting the world but as an instrument for questioning inherited narratives, asserting cultural agency and imagining alternative futures. The edition reinforces Bamako’s enduring significance as a centre for artistic production and critical discourse on the African continent. rencontresbamakophoto.org+1
The 15th Bamako Encounters takes place across venues in Bamako, Mali, from 26 November 2026 until 26 January 2027.
